bd-3aen: bd-e0xk parity gate — 6 e2e-hardened-loop scenarios bar-for-bar on --engine vs legacy.

PLAN:
1. Patched scripts/e2e-hardened-loop.sh: LOOP_EXTRA env injects extra loop flags (default empty = legacy) — same gate, both paths, 5 loop sites.
2. Run legacy first (baseline must hold), then LOOP_EXTRA=--engine. Each run: real herdr swarm (2 opencode agents), scratch project, 6 scenarios (baseline drain, crash-resume+dedup, state-file respawn, blocked alert, frozen escalation x3+hard-stop, unknown-agent documented limitation).
3. Compare PASS/FAIL per scenario — parity = identical outcomes. Note: --engine path defers escalation/respawn phases to later slices, so scenario 3/5 parity EXPECTED to differ (respawn machinery not yet engine-side); honest report, not a fake pass.

ENV: herdr up, Resonate:8001 up, fresh flywheel build installed (~/.local/bin, --engine verified).
FILES: scripts/e2e-hardened-loop.sh (reserved, exclusive).
